blocks.text: “40 Over 40” was an open call curated by Elizabeth Avedon . South x Southeast Gallery invited photographers from all backgrounds and experience levels—over the age of 40—to enter work across all subject matter, including street photography, portraits, nudes, landscapes, nature, wildlife, urban landscapes, architecture, and/or documentary photography.
“40 OVER 40” Juried by Elizabeth Avedon / South x Southeast Photo Gallery
